title: Yitzchak of Rabbi Yannai's school
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So it is in [Yoma 86a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.86a.11): he said, “What constitutes desecration of the Name? Anyone whose colleagues are embarrassed by his reputation.” Hyman argues that the name should read Yitzchak, son of Rabbi Ami, as in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2185&lang=en) name Yitzchak of Rabbi Yannai’s school.
Hyman proposes “Yitzchak, son of Rabbi Ami,” citing Dikdukei Soferim.
